T1-holdout.name: holdout
T1-holdout.weights: refit on days before 2023-07-01 (the set's rows, design, family and C)

T2.name: cross-season
T2.weights: refit per held-out season on the other seasons of 2016-17 … 2024-25
T2.volume_heads: refit per fold on the same seasons
T2.label: development (selection-contaminated)

T0.name: prospective
T0.weights: T1's finals, not refit, on every day after the freeze (shadow-run)
T0.use: confirmation: OUT's window is T1 post ∪ T0 (protocol §8)

windows.S5: S5's window, 2023-07-01 → the data end: T1-holdout ∪ T1 ∪ T0 (protocol §8)

reference: climatology per unit × calendar month ±1 on the fold's training days (protocol §4.2)

t0_as_served.words: No forecast_history snapshot is committed yet (features/forecast/data/forecast_history/t0_first_snapshots.csv; grade_prospective.py --export writes it): nothing the page showed in the live season is graded.

paired.s5_primary_rule: protocol §8: link_zone_swap − basin_swap on the conditional set, superiority (the 90% CI's upper bound below 0) on the perfect feed and on the degraded feed; window 'S5' = 2023-07-01 → the data end (T1-holdout ∪ T1 ∪ T0)

s5.chip: the perfect feed's zone-days in S5's window (Jul 2023 – Aug 2026), each zone-day once

integrity.partition: n_total = n_scored + Σ n_rule for every (stage, unit, entry, window): asserted by exclusions.counts

dropped.note: inputs: the days an entry has no frame (stages_entries: X-S1-NWPGAP / X-S1-NOLEAD), so no row at any stage; no_history_days: days of a window with an S2 row but no S4 / OUT row: a lead entry's target whose issue day lacks its forecast for one of I … D−1 (rain known: never)
